## Overview

### Why

DotField drew only a circle. A designer who wanted a triangle, a star, or a mix of marks had to fork the shader and write distance-field math in TSL.

### Behavior change

`shape` takes `'circle'`, `'cross'`, inline SVG, or a list of any mix. With a list, each cell picks one entry, and the pick holds still across frames.

### Checks

- Unit tests for the mark atlas plan and for the marks list.
- The dev probe at `/dev/dot-field-svg-probe` shows every case.

### Not covered

A custom mark softens past 96 device pixels. Playwright coverage comes in a later pull request.

## Pass the shape to the shader

`DotField` defaults `shape` to `'circle'`, so existing scenes draw what they drew before. The component hands the prop to `DotFieldShader` beside the others.

[](packages/shaders/src/components/dot-field/dot-field.tsx#L75-L92)
